study: Jaciw, Hegseth et al. 2016 / Empirical Education 2012 — Math in Focus (Singapore Math), HMH
eval_evidence: HMH contracted Empirical Education Inc. (a self-described independent research company) to conduct the RCT; report states the contract 'provided Empirical Education Inc. with independence in reporting the results.' Developer (HMH) sponsored but did not author the impact evaluation.
developer_evidence: PD was delivered by HMH's own staff — an HMH Account Manager / Associate Product Manager (Aug) and two HMH 'Math in Focus National Specialists' (Sept, Nov, Jan, Mar). HMH is the program developer/publisher, so the developer delivered the PD (not trained intermediaries).
cascade_evidence: HMH's National Specialists trained the Clark County teachers directly across the 5 sessions; no train-the-trainer/lead-teacher intermediary layer.
counterfactual_evidence: Control group received 'business as usual' — the district's existing variety of math methods/curricula; no alternative PD/program assigned.
coaching_evidence: Workshop-style PD (5 sessions Aug-Mar). The January session included an HMH Specialist modeling a lesson in one MIF teacher's classroom with a group debrief; this is a single in-class modeling visit, not recurring per-teacher in-class coaching cycles, so periodic/light = occasional.
student_dose_evidence: MIF was adopted as the CORE math curriculum (replacing the teacher's regular curriculum); only the teacher's classroom instruction changes. No tutoring, pull-out, extra minutes, or student-facing software dose.
maturity_evidence: Outcomes measured at the end of the single 2011-12 implementation year; teachers were new to Math in Focus (first year teaching it).
